sources.notes: Browser PDF parser. The tool uses public PDFPageProxy text/font objects; unused resources may not be observed.
Documents PDFPageProxy.commonObjs and page processing interfaces.

assumptions: Fonts encountered by PDF.js while extracting page text represent the fonts materially used on those pages.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: Unused resource fonts, some XFA/content paths, scanned-image PDFs and parser-internal font details may be absent. “Unknown” embedded status must not be treated as “not embedded”.
